This page gives **one-line roles** only.

- Instruments and status: [Official status](tracker.qmd) and [Timeline](dates.qmd)
- Term definitions: [Glossary](glossary.qmd)

**Comparators** (Mainland, EU, US) are for learning. They are **not** Hong Kong law.

## Two things to keep straight {#standing-caveats}

In plain words (details and dates on [Official status](tracker.qmd) and [Timeline](dates.qmd)):

1. **Hong Kong has two different trial programmes** — the first **Regulatory Sandbox** and later **[Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law)**. They are **not** the same list of projects. Do not mix their counts.
2. A **Shenzhen–Hong Kong / Greater Bay Area (GBA) cross-boundary corridor** is discussed in policy. On the evidence tracked here, **flights are not running on an operating corridor** as day-to-day service.

## Hong Kong

| Body | What it controls for this course |
|------|----------------------------------|
| [**Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy**](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Cross-government LAE strategy group (headed by the Deputy Financial Secretary; STL is Deputy Head). Selects Sandbox / Sandbox X projects. An Action Plan is still being formulated (text marked **OPEN**). |
| [**TLB** (Transport and Logistics Bureau)](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Policy bureau. Supports the Working Group secretariat. Runs Sandbox pilot projects by batches. Publishes Sandbox X module communications. |
| [**CAD** (Civil Aviation Department)](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Regulator for Cap. **448G** **SUA** (small unmanned aircraft). Issues sandbox Advisory Circulars. Designates restricted flying zones. Has a technical study role on the planned traffic-management system. |
| [**OFCA / Communications Authority**](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Spectrum licensing for the **1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence** (confined to LAE **Regulatory Sandbox** projects). CAD still approves relevant flight paths in that setting. |

```{=html}
<figure class="wdiag wdiag-svg" id="reg-hk-bodies" aria-labelledby="reg-hk-bodies-title">
<p class="wdiag-cap" id="reg-hk-bodies-title"><strong>Who decides what (Hong Kong)</strong> — Working Group (strategy; selects Sandbox / Sandbox X projects); TLB (policy bureau; Sandbox batches / Sandbox X modules); CAD (Cap. 448G SUA regulator; sandbox circulars); OFCA (1.4 GHz UAS Private Licence confined to Regulatory Sandbox). Keep Sandbox ≠ Sandbox X. U-space ≠ Hong Kong law. Mainland / EASA / FAA are comparators only.</p>
```

## Mainland (comparator)

| Body | What it controls for this course |
|------|----------------------------------|
| [**CAAC**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Civil Aviation Administration of China — responsible authority under **CCAR-92** for UAS operational safety. Publisher of ATM Rules Chapter 12 **draft** (not promulgated). |
| [**Ministry of Transport**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Promulgated **CCAR-92** (MOT Order 2024 No. 1; in force 1 Jan 2024). See Glossary diagram sources and [Official status](tracker.qmd). |
| [**NDRC**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Issued 发改低空〔2025〕**1676号** — a **statistical classification** of 低空经济 (low-altitude economy). Not an official national scale (规模) figure ([Official status](tracker.qmd)). |
| [**Guangdong Provincial People’s Government General Office**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Issued 粤府办〔2024〕**6号** (LAE action plan 2024–2026). GBA corridor language is a **policy aim**, not evidence of an operating Shenzhen–Hong Kong corridor ([Glossary](glossary.qmd#who-regulates-what); [Official status](tracker.qmd)). |

Related Mainland instruments (status on Official status / Timeline): **国令761**, National Airspace Basic Classification, Civil Aviation Law (2025 revision).

## EU / US (course comparators)

These are **not** Hong Kong regulators. Use them for frameworks and readings — not for Hong Kong compliance claims.

| Body | What students use it for here |
|------|-------------------------------|
| [**EASA**](glossary.qmd#eu-us-comparators) | EU Aviation Safety Agency — **U-space** framework as a comparator (**U-space is not Hong Kong law**); SC-VTOL / VTOL certification material; prototype vertiport design specs. Dated rows on [Timeline](dates.qmd); documents on the week pages under **Teach**. |
| [**FAA**](glossary.qmd#eu-us-comparators) | US Federal Aviation Administration — UTM / UAM concepts of operations; Remote ID; powered-lift and AAM implementation plan as course comparators. Dated rows on [Timeline](dates.qmd); documents on the week pages under **Teach**. |

[Course overview](overview.qmd) also names NASA, AiRMOUR, and other AAM frameworks as comparators — not decision-makers for Hong Kong flights.
